caption: The drawing features a single, vertically oriented object centered on a plain, off-white background. The object is outlined in thin black lines and has an elongated, symmetrical, and streamlined shape that tapers to points at both the top and bottom. The upper section is rounded, gradually narrowing as it moves downward, with a pointed tip at the very top that contains some simple internal detailing. The midsection is wider and then narrows again into a thin lower portion, which ends in another pointed tip with a small open notch. Around the lower-mid area of the object, there are two pairs of curved, elongated shapes that face inward, drawn with fine lines. The name "CHARLES GARJIAN" is faintly printed in capital letters near the lower left corner of the image. The background is plain with slight discoloration in some areas. The entire composition utilizes only black lines on a neutral background without additional colors or shading.
title: Decoy (Red-Wing Black Bird)
